description: This PHP source file defines the ParamRule class used for validating API parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to set and get validation rules, default values, and composite rule types, and enforces allowed composite types.

classes.name: ParamRule
classes.description: Represents validation rules for a specific parameter, including its key, associated rules, default value, and composite validation class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ParamRule instance with a parameter key and a variable number of rules.

methods.name: getParamKey
methods.description: Returns the parameter key associated with this rule.

methods.name: setParamKey
methods.description: Sets the parameter key for this rule.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Retrieves the array of rules associated with this parameter.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets the array of rules for this parameter.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Gets the default value for this parameter.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default value for this parameter.

methods.name: getCompositeClass
methods.description: Returns the current composite validation class.

methods.name: setCompositeClass
methods.description: Sets the composite validation class; validates input against allowed values.
